title: Verified representation synthesis: does a calibrated semantic geometry preserve future-relevant computation while enabling selective execution?
question: When a representation is synthesized from a domain description, calibrated with explicit anchors, and frozen before outcome evaluation, does it preserve the state distinctions needed for future computation while supporting capability-constrained selective execution?
hypothesis: A semantically synthesized and calibrated multidimensional representation will preserve more task-relevant future behavior than a scalar baseline at matched abstraction budgets, and any representation that appears locally compact but fails dynamic equivalence will be rejected by the registered downstream verifier rather than promoted from semantic plausibility alone.

arms.name: raw_state
arms.intervention: retain the complete router-visible persistent state representation without abstraction; capability reference

arms.name: scalar_baseline
arms.intervention: compress each state to the registered scalar relevance/value coordinate

arms.name: semantic_geometry
arms.intervention: use a frozen multidimensional representation synthesized from the domain description, with explicit 0/0.5/1 calibration anchors and training-only numerical filtering

arms.name: oracle_behavioral
arms.intervention: diagnostic-only representation derived from exhaustive future action/outcome behavior; not eligible for the primary capability-cost endpoint

endpoints.name: capability_constrained_execution_work_fraction
endpoints.role: primary — minimum measured execution-work fraction among registered abstractions that retain >=0.80 capability relative to raw-state reference
endpoints.description: At each registered population level, identify the lowest measured downstream exact-task evaluation work fraction among registered abstraction budgets whose exact-task success is at least 0.80 of the raw-state reference.

endpoints.name: dynamic_equivalence_violation
endpoints.role: secondary — rate at which states judged equivalent by the representation exhibit materially different future behavior under registered actions
endpoints.description: Conditional violation rate over representation-near state pairs under one- and multi-step action-conditioned transition checks.

endpoints.name: future_capability_retention
endpoints.role: secondary — exact task capability after abstraction relative to raw-state reference

endpoints.name: representation_anchor_consistency
endpoints.role: secondary — stability of calibrated feature semantics across batches and temporal checkpoints

endpoints.name: representation_effective_rank
endpoints.role: secondary — effective rank of the representation and concentration diagnostics

endpoints.name: state_routing_work
endpoints.role: secondary — actual addressing/routing operations before structural execution

endpoints.name: operator_execution_work
endpoints.role: secondary — actual structural execution work after state selection

endpoints.name: amortized_representation_build_cost
endpoints.role: secondary — one-time semantic representation construction cost amortized over declared query count

endpoints.name: representation_build_break_even_queries
endpoints.role: secondary — query count required for synthesized-representation construction cost to break even against the matched runtime control
endpoints.description: Derived only when semantic representation construction reduces steady-state cost; reports the declared amortization horizon needed to recover one-time construction cost.

held_constant: exact task generator, target-disjoint evaluation construction, verifier, exact executor, seeds, and capability definition
representation proposal is generated before confirmatory evaluation and then frozen; outcome data cannot modify the proposal
all non-oracle arms use the same downstream router capacity and optimizer budget where a learned router is used
calibration anchors are fixed before state scoring and reused across all batches
raw-state reference defines capability without representation compression and is not eligible as a selective-computation improvement claim
oracle_behavioral is diagnostic-only and cannot win the primary endpoint
actual structural execution work is counted from executed graph operations rather than proxy arithmetic
representation build cost and steady-state query cost are reported separately and the amortization horizon is declared
all train/evaluation exact structures, truth tables, and target identities are independently hashed and split before measurement

numeric constants are fixed before confirmatory measurement: normalized near-pair distance threshold 0.35, dynamic outcome divergence tolerance 0, state-feature variance floor 1e-6, feature absolute-correlation filter 0.98, exact-task evaluation work 12 units per executed candidate

proposal generation may see only the frozen domain description, public state descriptions needed to evaluate the representation, and public task descriptions needed to produce query coordinates; outcomes, target identities, truth tables, benchmark results, and post-action states are forbidden

decision_rule.condition: All Layer 0/1 integrity gates pass and the frozen semantic representation is deterministic under the declared proposal artifact.
decision_rule.licenses: the representation is eligible for downstream testing.

decision_rule.condition: At a population level, semantic_geometry reaches >=0.80 capability retention and has lower actual execution-work fraction than the scalar_baseline under the same registered abstraction budget.
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that synthesized multidimensional representation improves capability-constrained selective computation on the registered workload.
decision_rule.does_not_license: asymptotic scaling, general language intelligence, or superiority over all representation methods.

decision_rule.condition: semantic_geometry meets capability retention but fails the dynamic-equivalence gate beyond the registered tolerance.
decision_rule.licenses: the representation is useful for the measured static task but dynamically unsafe under the registered transition test; it is not admitted as a persistent representation.

decision_rule.condition: no registered semantic_geometry budget reaches 0.80 retention.
decision_rule.licenses: the registered synthesized representation does not meet the bounded selective-computation criterion at that population.
decision_rule.does_not_license: an impossibility claim about representation synthesis.

interpretation_order: proposal artifact provenance and prompt/model freeze

amendments.old_definition: Dynamic test pairs were described as near-neighbor state pairs selected under the frozen geometry; the registration did not explicitly require pair construction to precede representation scoring.
amendments.new_definition: State-pair identities and action schedules are generated and hashed independently of the representation before any representation is scored; the representation only determines which fixed pairs satisfy the preregistered near-neighbor threshold. The contract also explicitly records representation-build break-even accounting.
amendments.rationale: Methodological integrity review identified post-representation pair selection as a potential selection bias: a representation could avoid difficult pairs by changing which states count as neighbors. The amendment closes that pathway before measurement and adds explicit amortization accounting for the cost of semantic representation construction.
amendments.discovered: 2026-10-02 review of the preregistered VRS design, before any confirmatory measurement.
amendments.affected: dynamic equivalence denominator, pair construction protocol, and cost reporting; no population, seed, capability threshold, representation arm, or outcome was measured under the previous definition.
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: No VRS measurement was run under the previous definition.

amendments.old_definition: A dynamic-validation result was considered a pass whenever no recorded violations existed.
amendments.new_definition: A dynamic-validation result is admissible only when at least one fixed representation-near pair and at least one transition are actually evaluated; zero applicable pairs is an instrument-invalid result, not a pass. Declared action-horizon lengths must also match exactly.
amendments.rationale: Instrument review found that a representation could move every fixed test pair outside the near-neighbor threshold and thereby obtain a vacuous pass with zero dynamic evidence. The gate must distinguish 'no violations observed' from 'nothing was tested'.
amendments.discovered: 2026-10-02 validator implementation review, before any VRS confirmatory measurement.
amendments.affected: only validation applicability and action-schedule integrity; no scientific population, seed, arm, endpoint threshold, or outcome was measured under the previous definition.
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: No VRS measurement was run under the previous definition.

amendments.applies_to: implementation baseline, proposal artifact boundary, numeric validation thresholds, and execution-work instrument
amendments.old_definition: The contract left the exact master baseline, proposal scoring artifact contents, near-pair numeric threshold, dynamic outcome tolerance, representation-filter thresholds, and exact downstream work unit unspecified.
amendments.new_definition: Confirmatory VRS uses master@eadc884341b7ca42d52b2965eddfabb428eb3621; the semantic proposal must be an external frozen scored artifact containing complete registered state/task coverage plus proposer/prompt/domain provenance; numeric constants are fixed at near-pair distance <=0.35, dynamic outcome divergence tolerance 0, variance floor 1e-6, correlation filter 0.98; downstream exact-task evaluation counts 12 work units per executed candidate.
amendments.rationale: An implementation can otherwise choose these values after seeing data, creating researcher degrees of freedom that invalidate the registered primary endpoint.
amendments.affected: only implementation specification and auditability; no VRS confirmatory outcome exists under the superseded definition.
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: No VRS confirmatory measurement was run before A3.

amendments.applies_to: proposal input visibility and representation-neighbor metric
amendments.old_definition: The protocol described proposal inputs as the domain/task specification and treated the near-pair threshold as a raw Euclidean distance, leaving the exact visible state/task data boundary and dimension normalization implicit.
amendments.new_definition: The proposer may use the frozen domain description plus public state/task descriptions needed to compute state and query coordinates, but no action outcomes, target identities, truth tables, verifier outputs, or benchmark results. Representation-neighbor distance is normalized Euclidean distance divided by sqrt(retained dimension), with threshold <=0.35. All four finite one-step actions are evaluated exhaustively; multi-step checks use the fixed seeded schedules.
amendments.rationale: A scored external representation necessarily needs state/task values to materialize coordinates. Making that visibility explicit prevents an impossible/ambiguous interface from being silently interpreted as unrestricted benchmark access. Dimension-normalized distance prevents changing the number of retained dimensions from mechanically changing the neighbor criterion.
amendments.discovered: 2026-10-02 methodological review, before any VRS confirmatory measurement.
amendments.affected: proposal-generation input contract, dynamic pair metric, and one-step action coverage; no VRS confirmatory outcome exists under the previous definition.
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: No VRS confirmatory measurement was run before A4.

amendments.applies_to: benchmark leakage and proposer input boundary
amendments.old_definition: The proposal protocol used a domain-description hash that could refer to a document containing the exact downstream task score, making the evaluator definition potentially visible to the representation proposer.
amendments.new_definition: The only proposer-visible domain artifact is research/vrs-001/PROPOSER-DOMAIN-001.md, frozen and hashed. The benchmark-private DOMAIN-001.md contains evaluator-side score/safety details and is forbidden as proposer input. The external scored artifact must carry the SHA-256 of the proposer-visible domain artifact.
amendments.rationale: Providing the exact evaluation objective to the abstraction generator would convert representation discovery into objective-specific feature reconstruction and invalidate the intended pre-evaluator abstraction boundary.
amendments.discovered: 2026-10-02 benchmark leakage review, before any VRS confirmatory measurement.
amendments.affected: proposer input visibility and domain provenance; no VRS confirmatory outcome exists under the previous definition.
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: No VRS confirmatory measurement was run before A5.

level_semantics.h_levels: The shared ExperimentContract field h_levels is used for persistent-state population M because the contract schema predates explicit M/E/H terminology. This semantic mapping is fixed for this experiment and is not a change to the scientific variable.

scaling_axes.note: E is held fixed in this representation-validation phase. Joint M×E×H scaling is a later experiment and is not inferred here.

proposal_protocol.representation_family: multidimensional semantic features proposed from a frozen natural-language domain description, then calibrated with explicit anchor states
proposal_protocol.proposer_role: slow semantic representation synthesis; not runtime inference
proposal_protocol.proposal_inputs: research/vrs-001/PROPOSER-DOMAIN-001.md plus the public state/task rows generated for the frozen universe; no benchmark-private evaluator specification is visible to the proposer
proposal_protocol.scoring: proposal features are applied consistently across all batches using the same anchors
proposal_protocol.numerical_postprocessing: training-only variance/correlation filtering and fixed rescaling; no post-result feature selection
proposal_protocol.artifact_requirement: proposal text, feature definitions, anchor definitions, proposer model identifier, prompt hash, generation timestamp, temperature/decoding settings, and full scored-feature artifact must be frozen before confirmatory evaluation

external_artifact.smoke_fixture_policy: research/vrs-001/proposal_smoke.json is expression-based and may be used only for smoke tests; it is invalid for confirmatory evidence.

input_visibility.attestation_required: outcome_visibility must equal 'none' and the generation artifact must record the frozen prompt/model provenance

dynamic_validity.near_pair_definition: For the fixed pre-generated pair set, select the representation-near subset using normalized Euclidean distance (raw Euclidean distance divided by sqrt of retained representation dimension) with the preregistered threshold after calibration. The denominator and pair identities are fixed before representation generation; no post-hoc pair construction is allowed.
dynamic_validity.one_step_test: for each registered action a, compare successor safety outcomes for every fixed one-step pair; the finite four-action one-step space is evaluated exhaustively
dynamic_validity.multi_step_test: for each registered multi-step horizon k in history_delay_k, evaluate the representation against the fixed seeded action schedule for each fixed near pair
dynamic_validity.failure_evidence: counterexample trajectory is stored with the representation coordinates, action, successor states, and verifier outcome
dynamic_validity.principle: static similarity does not license persistent equivalence unless future behavior is preserved
dynamic_validity.fixed_pair_construction: State-pair evaluation sets are generated and hashed before any representation is scored. Pair membership is independent of all representation coordinates. The representation only determines which fixed pairs satisfy the registered near-neighbor threshold.
dynamic_validity.action_sampling: Actions and multi-step schedules are fixed by the task generator before representation evaluation. Where the action space is finite and tractable, all relevant actions are evaluated; otherwise a representation-independent seeded action subset is fixed in the contract.
dynamic_validity.vacuous_pass: Forbidden. If zero near pairs or zero transitions are evaluated, the test is instrument-inapplicable and cannot admit the representation.
dynamic_validity.comparison_rule: For each fixed representation-near pair and each fixed action in the registered schedule, dynamic validity is violated when the exact future safety outcome differs between paired states. Successor-coordinate divergence is diagnostic only in VRS-001 because the frozen proposal artifact scores the fixed state universe, not arbitrary successors.
dynamic_validity.denominator: checked_transitions over representation-near pairs from the fixed pair set

cost_model.total: C_rep_build + C_state_address + C_state_route + C_operator_select + C_exec + C_verify + C_write + C_IO
cost_model.primary_runtime: steady-state query cost excludes one-time representation construction only when amortization is separately reported
cost_model.requirement: no proxy term may be substituted for actual execution work in the primary endpoint
cost_model.break_even: Q_break_even is admissible only when proposal provenance explicitly declares build_cost_unit='execution_work_units'. Otherwise representation construction cost is reported but no break-even claim is computed.
cost_model.primary: actual downstream exact-task evaluation work; state-routing work is reported separately

prior_art: Abstraction Agent, arXiv:2609.04303 — LLM-discovered calibrated continuous strategic features plus downstream solver verification
VERDI, arXiv:2608.09537 — retrieved experience remains a hypothesis until target-side validation; diagnostic fingerprints evolve under contradiction

Compositional Behavioral Semantics for State Abstraction in Reinforcement Learning, ICML 2026 / arXiv:2606.25357 — behavioral structures can be specified compositionally with soundness-oriented transfer conditions
not_inherited: Abstraction Agent does not establish dynamic equivalence under future transitions
Abstraction Agent does not establish persistent state evolution or selective operator execution
VERDI does not establish the representation used here or a universal transfer law
Behavioral-semantics theory does not validate an LLM-synthesized representation on this benchmark

nonclaims: no asymptotic complexity claim from finite population levels
no claim that Euclidean geometry is intrinsic to the environment
no claim that LLM semantic scoring is correct merely because parsing succeeds
no claim that representation compression is safe without dynamic verification
no claim that the semantic representation replaces exact state evidence
no dynamic-validity claim from representation-selected pairs; pair identities must be fixed independently of the representation

confirmatory_implementation.proposal_freeze: proposal artifact must be complete before the benchmark and its digest is included in the result
